title: Federal Register: Agency Information Collection Activities: Submission for OMB Review (CMS-10545, OASIS-E1), 30-day notice

history.reason: Source read directly on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (via GovInfo / Federal Register)
source_type: Government Paperwork Reduction Act information collection notice
reliability: Government document; the issuing agency (CMS) is also the party imposing and administering the requirement. Figures are CMS ex ante burden estimates, not measured time.
findings: CMS states HHAs are required to collect the Outcome and Assessment Information Set (OASIS) to participate in the Medicare program.
CMS seeks OMB approval for OASIS-E1, scheduled for implementation in the Home Health Quality Reporting Program on January 1, 2025, replacing OASIS-E (implemented January 1, 2023).
OASIS-E1 changes: addition of one item supporting a quality measure, removal of one item due to retirement of a measure, removal of two data elements no longer used.
Stated burden for CMS-10545 (OMB 0938-1279): 11,866 respondents; 18,017,056 total annual responses; 16,683,290 total annual hours.
The same respondent, response and hour figures appear in the 60-day notice published April 5, 2024 (FR Doc. 2024-07202), which was also read.
limitations: Estimate prepared by the regulator for the Paperwork Reduction Act; actual time per assessment, staffing cost and software effects are not measured here.
The notice gives totals only; per-response minutes and per-agency figures in this record set are derived by arithmetic, not stated by CMS.
Respondent count covers all HHAs, not only small agencies; no size breakdown is given.
Burden figures are for the 2025 OASIS-E1 version; later OASIS versions or revised estimates were not read.
Dollar cost per hour and which staff complete OASIS were not extracted from this notice.
